scope: Independent read-only Python lane review; no suite/native compile/simulator/solve execution

findings.problem: When any source contact has AdditionalContactIDs, _depth_regions groups every contact by primary ID, relaxing existing per-node published-depth checks for unrelated contacts.
findings.reproduction: Two edge components each Z20 positioned at [-30,-10] and [10,30], published edge60: fail without sharing; pass once unrelated jug/pinch shared pair added.
findings.recommendedFix: Use logical membership union only for IDs present in additionalContactIDs; preserve per-node measurements for IDs that receive no additional membership.
findings.resolution: Only IDs explicitly targeted by additionalContactIDs use union grouping. Others retain legacy per-node checks, independently confirmed by actual-function probe.
